name: aqueli
description: A private, all-in-one organiser for Windows. Tasks, calendar, notes, habits and budget, encrypted and entirely offline.
readme_summary: Aqueli is a private, all-in-one personal organizer for Windows that consolidates tasks, calendar events, notes, habit tracking, and budgeting into a single, offline application. It emphasizes user privacy with local-first storage and end-to-end encryption, offering a customizable interface with a retro-inspired aesthetic.
key_features: All-in-one organizer (tasks, calendar, notes, habits, budget)
No account creation, cloud, or subscription
Bill and subscription tracking with reminders
primary_use_case: To provide a comprehensive, private, and secure personal organization tool for Windows users, consolidating daily life management into a single, offline desktop application.
cover_image_prompt: A stylized, open vintage wooden chest overflowing with organized digital elements: glowing task lists, a spinning calendar dial, neatly stacked digital notes, and a small ledger showing balanced finances. The chest sits on a polished wooden desk in a cozy, dimly lit study, with subtle light rays illuminating the organized contents. Small, ethereal digital particles representing encrypted data float around the chest. The repository name 'Aqueli' is subtly etched onto the side of the chest. The overall mood is one of secure, private organization and peace of mind. 3D isometric illustration style with a focus on clear, intuitive iconography and a warm, inviting color palette.

name: cloofy
description: Spotify in your terminal: plays on its own, with Home and the DJ, synced lyrics, real cover art and full mouse support.
readme_summary: cloofy is a Rust-based Spotify client that runs entirely within the terminal. It offers a full-featured music playback experience, including synced lyrics, cover art, and integration with Spotify Connect, all without requiring an official Spotify app or daemon.
key_features: Acts as a Spotify Connect device
Displays synced lyrics and cover art
Provides instant playback and UI state restoration
primary_use_case: To provide a fully functional Spotify music player experience within a terminal environment, offering features comparable to the official desktop client.
cover_image_prompt: A stylized, glowing terminal window is open, revealing a vibrant, miniature concert hall inside. A conductor, represented by a mouse cursor, is orchestrating the music. Sheet music scrolls on a small screen within the terminal, displaying synchronized lyrics that pulse with the music. Instead of traditional instruments, small, abstract digital sound waves emanate from within the terminal, forming the shape of album covers. The overall mood is magical and immersive, highlighting the seamless blend of music, lyrics, and terminal interface. The 'cloofy' logo is subtly integrated into the terminal's frame. Style: 3D isometric illustration with glowing neon accents and a dark, futuristic background.

name: survival-llm
description: A free AI assistant and survival library that runs on your own computer, with no internet needed. Shows the source of every answer.
readme_summary: Survival LLM is a free, offline AI assistant and survival library that runs locally on your computer. It answers questions by searching an extensive offline library of medical, emergency, and how-to articles, providing cited sources and detailed reasoning for its responses.
key_features: Ability to add and search personal files (PDF, DOC, EPUB, HTML, TXT)
Extensive built-in library of survival and medical information
primary_use_case: To provide users with an offline, private AI assistant for accessing survival, medical, and how-to information without requiring an internet connection.
cover_image_prompt: A wise, old librarian sitting at a sturdy wooden desk in a cozy, dimly lit study, surrounded by shelves packed with ancient books and modern manuals. In front of the librarian is a glowing, ethereal orb representing the AI. The librarian is pointing to a specific passage in an open book, which is simultaneously highlighted within the glowing orb. Scattered around the desk are various input items: a rolled-up emergency preparedness map, a medical first-aid kit, and a digital tablet displaying a generator manual. Subtle digital particles flow from the books to the orb, symbolizing knowledge transfer. The overall mood is one of calm preparedness and accessible knowledge. The style should be a warm, inviting digital painting with clear outlines and a focus on the interaction between physical knowledge and AI processing.

name: vibra-code
description: Open-Source AI App Builder for Mobile — Build apps with AI like vibecodeapp, rork, lovable & bolt.new but fully open source. Describe what you want → AI builds it → Preview on your phone. Built with Claude Code, Expo, React Native, Convex, E2B.
readme_summary: Vibra Code is an open-source AI app builder that allows users to describe mobile applications in plain English, which are then generated by AI and previewed on a phone. It offers a self-hostable alternative to closed-source platforms, enabling customization of AI prompts and providers.
key_features: Describe what you want, AI builds it
primary_use_case: Building mobile applications using natural language descriptions powered by AI, with the ability to self-host and customize the development process.
cover_image_prompt: A whimsical alchemist in a vibrant, modern workshop, holding a glowing scroll with simple English text. Before them, a magical workbench transforms the text into a miniature, fully formed mobile app that floats in the air, emitting soft light. Small, stylized icons representing code and phone interfaces subtly appear around the workbench. The background shows a clean, organized space with shelves holding various AI-related tools and components. The overall mood is creative and empowering, with a focus on the seamless transition from idea to functional app. Style: 3D isometric illustration, clean lines, bright and inviting color palette.

name: pocketpaw
description: Your AI agent in 30 seconds. Not 30 hours. Self-hosted, open-source personal AI with desktop installer, multi-agent Command Center(Deep Work), and 7-layer security. Anthropic, OpenAI, or Ollama.
readme_summary: PocketPaw is a self-hosted, open-source personal AI agent designed for quick deployment. It offers a desktop installer and a web dashboard, integrating with various communication platforms and AI models like OpenAI, Anthropic, or Ollama, while prioritizing user data privacy.
key_features: Integration with Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Telegram, and browser
Support for Anthropic, OpenAI, or Ollama models
primary_use_case: To provide users with a private, self-hosted personal AI assistant that can be easily installed and integrated into their daily communication workflows.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, stylized paw print character acting as a personal assistant, sitting at a clean, modern desk. The paw is holding a glowing orb representing AI intelligence, with digital streams of data flowing from the orb towards various communication icons (Discord, Slack, Telegram, browser) arranged neatly on the desk. Subtle code snippets and security shield icons are visible in the background, emphasizing self-hosting and security. The overall mood is helpful and efficient, with a clean, bright aesthetic. The art style should be a 3D isometric illustration with soft lighting and clear iconography.
